title: Pronouns
desc: Words used to refer to people (e.g. I, you, we) as the subject of a sentence.

title: Objective-Pronouns
desc: Pronouns used as the object of a verb or preposition (e.g. me, him, us).

title: Prepositions
desc: Words that show relationships between nouns or pronouns and other words (e.g. in, on, with).

title: Interrogative-Words
desc: Words used to ask questions (e.g. who, what, where). Note: In arabic Objective Pronouns and Possessive Pronounsa are almost same execpt for 'I' that is 'ni' and 'i-' respectively.
